sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The ⚠⟳ "retry only what failed" buttons — for cover art, event art and relationships — now also appear on each sub-table, counting that sub-table's own failures. The page-wide one beside the main heading stays, so you can repair one section or the whole page, exactly as the ⟳ and 🔗⟳ reload buttons have always worked.
Each of them joins its own group's pill, so a sub-table with failures reads as one control: toggle, count, reload, and retry-what-failed.

The counts are taken from the rows themselves rather than from what is currently on screen, so filtering the table does not make them shrink — and a button never disappears while a filter is hiding the very rows it would repair.
